solves.reasoning: (A): estimated(추정된)가 맞음 (calculated는 수치 계산에 더 적합). (B): fortunate(운 좋게)이 맞음 (reluctant=꺼리는=반대). (C): evidence(증거)가 맞음 (confusion=혼란=반대). → estimated/fortunate/evidence = ②
(A): chassis(차대/몸체)가 원문. (B): affectionate(애정 어린)이 원문. (C): superior(우수한)이 원문. → chassis/affectionate/superior = ①
(A): nostalgically(향수에 젖어)가 맞음 (enthusiastically=열정적으로=뉘앙스 다름). (B): scrap(폐기)이 맞음 (repair=수리=반대). (C): fondness(애착)가 맞음 (curiosity=호기심=다른 의미). → nostalgically/scrap/fondness = ④
①spread(맞음), ②affectionate(맞음), ③vanished('survived at least fifty-eight years'가 원문인데 vanished=사라진=정반대로 부적절), ④hold on to(맞음) → ③
①fortunate(맞음), ②commenced('stopped in 1964'가 원문, commenced=시작=반대로 부적절), ③nostalgically(맞음), ④fondness(맞음) → ②
①superior(맞음), ②scrap(맞음), ③developed(맞음), ④let go of('hold on to'가 원문, let go of=놓아버리다=정반대로 부적절) → ④
'The fact that the tractor has _____ at least fifty-eight years seems to provide evidence' → 58년간 살아남았다는 맥락 → survived(생존했다) = ②
'you might be fortunate enough to _____ a classic tractor' → 운 좋게 우연히 발견하다 → stumble across = ④
'it might well be the _____ that people in Ireland have for the little red tractor' → 아일랜드 사람들의 애착 → fondness = ①
estimated=추정된. 1.approximated(추정된=동의어) 2.confirmed(확인된) 3.demanded(요구된) 4.overlooked(간과된) → approximated = ①
evidence=증거. 1.obstacle(장애물) 2.remedy(해결책) 3.proof(증거=동의어) 4.threat(위협) → proof = ③
fondness=애착/좋아함. 1.hostility(적대감) 2.affection(애정=동의어) 3.caution(주의) 4.frustration(좌절) → affection = ②
superior=우수한. 반의어: 1.adequate(충분한) 2.notable(눈에 띄는) 3.identical(동일한) 4.inferior(열등한=반의어) → inferior = ④
affectionate=애정 어린. 반의어: 1.cold-hearted(냉정한=반의어) 2.generous(관대한) 3.cautious(조심스러운) 4.modest(겸손한) → cold-hearted = ①
(A) 'strike up a conversation' → strike up=시작하다. (B) 'decided to strike until demands were met' → strike=파업하다. → (A)시작하다-(B)파업하다 = ③
'the main frame or body of a vehicle, to which other parts are attached' = chassis(차대). 1.engine 2.wheel 3.chassis 4.antenna → chassis = ③
'give...tap and __________(nostalgia) remark' → remark를 수식하는 부사 필요 → nostalgically
'Massey Ferguson 35 tractors __________(produce) between 1956 and 1964' → tractors를 수식하는 과거분사(수동) → produced
'The fact that the tractor has survived at least fifty-eight years _____' → 생존이 품질의 증거를 제공하는 것처럼 보인다 → 'seems to provide evidence of its superior build quality' = ②
'it might well be the fondness...that has led farmers there to _____ and take care of them' → 트랙터를 간직한다 → 'hold on to their Massey Fergusons' = ④
